newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ farm input prices fall 1.1 pct in March qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ farm input prices fall 1.1 pct in March qtr.

text.p: All farm inputs excluding livestock decreased on average by 1.1 percent in the March quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Wednesday.
The index rose 0.5 percent in the December quarter and 0.8 in the March year.
Most of the quarterly fall was due to a fall in interest rates. A much smaller contribution came from the drop in prices for grazing, stock food and road freight.
These were slightly offset by higher wages and salaries.

In the quarter, the level of input prices for dairy farms fell 1.3 percent, sheep and beef farms' input prices fell 1.2 percent, horticultural farms' input prices fell 0.7 percent, and cropping and other farms' input prices fell 0.5 percent.
